headline: USS Abraham LINCOLN 🛳️ Docks in Pattaya 🍆 After RECORD 250 DAYS 🌊 at Sea
text:
After a RECORD 🏆 250 days 🌊 at sea 🛳️ without any port 🛑 stop the nuclear ⚛️ powered aircraft carrier 🛫 USS Abraham Lincoln has finally DOCKED ⚓ in Thailand 🇹🇭 giving its nearly 5000 crew 👦 members a much needed BREAK 🍑 from the endless blue 🟦 waves 🌊!! The ship 🛳️ is docking right by the beach 🏖️ resort of Pattaya known for its RAUCOUS 🍆 nightlife 🌃 and for its infamous sex 🥵 tourism which carries STRONG 💪 historical echoes 📜 from the Vietnam 🪖 era that transformed this sleepy 🐟 fishing village into one of the world's most frenetic PARTY 🕺 towns bro!! When the weary sailors 👟 finally walk into the city's bars 🍻 and restaurants 🍜 they will literally be treading in the FOOTSTEPS 👣 of hundreds of thousands of US troops who came here for R&R 🛌 during the Vietnam War and basically built this whole vibe from scratch 🛠️.

Today the neon lit 🪩 alleys running down to the beach 🏖️ are much quieter 🤫 than usual with bars 🍸 in the famous Walking Street still screening videos 📺 of pole dancing 💃 women trying to lure customers inside but there are not many of those customers and most seem to be family groups 👨‍👩‍👧 from the Middle East more interested in the Turkish ice cream 🍦 vendor than the go go bars which is kinda wild 🐺 after the Iran conflict really hit tourism and consumer spending HARD 💥 here!! The prospect of thousands of American sailors with nine months of salary 💰 unspent while at sea offers a rare opportunity for local businesses and one gem seller Anon Saiteer straight up said this visit could be our BEST HOPE 🙏 we have nothing to lose just hope they spend some money here while his shop put up a giant welcome sign for the US sailors and marines offering special discounts 🏷️.

The US carrier left San Diego last November on what was supposed to be a six month assignment in the Pacific and South China Sea but the ship was DIVERTED 🔀 to the Gulf after the US and Israel began military operations against Iran in late February which led to some members of Congress raising concerns about reports of food shortages 🍔 broken toilets 🚽 and mental stress 😣 among the crew!! The US Navy acknowledged that working conditions have been tough but said the crew were sufficiently well supported and it would not comment to the BBC on the carrier docking at Pattaya citing operational security which makes total sense given this is probably the largest number of US military personnel coming straight from a war zone to Pattaya since the fall of Saigon in 1975 🌴.

US and Thai officials are trying to ensure this shore leave happens without any of the SALACIOUS 🍑 headlines for which Pattaya has become known so the Thai authorities have said there are a few places where the US servicemen and women will not be allowed to go including Soi 6 which runs down to the main beach and is known for its concentration of racy go go bars where sex workers stand outside imploring men to come inside!! The many cannabis shops 🌿 in Pattaya are also off limits to US crew members along with sea sports like paragliding 🪂 and jet skis 🛥️ because Mayor Poramase Ngampiches told the BBC it is their decision and the US military have done their homework on keeping things from getting too WILD 🐺.

US Naval Attache Kristopher Robinson rebuffed questions from the BBC about activities that soldiers were banned from doing instead he said the US troops would conduct themselves in accordance with US law US naval regulations and the laws of Thailand while adding we're trying to give the sailors as much opportunity for rest as they can after being out there for 250 days straight!! The US Navy has organised shuttle buses 🚌 from the port into Pattaya running from 5am to 2am every day the carrier is here in Thailand and two hotels 🏨 have been designated suitable for those US crew members who want to splash out on a night onshore with Thai authorities deploying hundreds of police officers 👮 to keep an eye on the city's entertainment zones and warning local businesses not to overcharge their American guests.

The visits of US military men 50 60 years ago introduced Pattaya to the world and turned it into a tourist attraction says Mayor Poramase we have to be frank the city has a reputation for bar girls we understand the stereotypes we can't stop that but what we can do is show that Pattaya has changed with sports 🏀 seminars wellness and family friendly activities it's a mixture of everything!! Both countries hope that by the time the USS Abraham Lincoln begins the long journey home across the Pacific on 6 September it will be with a refreshed and rested crew after this much needed break from the floating prison vibes that had everyone down bad for months at sea 🌊.
